intro.content: At AfriNuts Export, we're not just building a business - we're creating a movement that combines ethical agribusiness, Islamic values, and sustainable development to revolutionize the cashew sector in Ivory Coast and beyond.

cta.title: A Movement Rooted in Vision
cta.content: Our goal is not just profitability — but to transform our region into a hub of ethical agribusiness. We're planting 3,500 cashew trees today to nourish the next generation — with faith, purpose, and excellence.

esg.title: Our Commitment to ESG
esg.content: At AfriNuts, our vision is deeply aligned with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. We are building a carbon-neutral, zero-waste cashew supply chain powered by renewable energy, organic farming, and blockchain traceability. Our social mission prioritizes fair trade, local job creation, clean water access, and Islamic financial ethics, reinvesting in the community and empowering future generations. With full transparency, ethical investor terms, and a commitment to sustainability at every step, AfriNuts is proud to be Africa's ESG-first cashew initiative.

roadmap.title: Our Strategic Roadmap: From Farm to Global Brand
roadmap.subtitle: Building a sustainable future through strategic growth and certification excellence

items.title: Foundation Phase: Farm & Supply Chain Secured
items.description: 35-hectare cashew farm fully operational in Odienné. Exclusive sourcing agreement signed with Coopérative Agricole AfriNuts, uniting 200+ local farmers.

items.title: Certification Initiation & Detailed Planning
items.description: Begin the 3-year transition for Organic certification. Finalize processing plant engineering designs, secure permits, and prepare for investment round.

items.title: Investment & Construction
items.description: Secure $1.25M investment. Break ground and construct the Phase 1 Pilot Processing Center. Begin applications for Halal and ISO 22000 certifications.

items.title: Commissioning & Market Entry
items.description: Install equipment, commission the plant, and train staff. Produce first sample batches for international buyers. Secure first Letters of Intent (LOIs).

items.title: Pilot Operations & Certification Achievement
items.description: Begin pilot-scale processing using farm and cooperative supply. Achieve full Organic, Halal, and ISO 22000 certifications. Ramp up production and refine operations.

items.title: Ramp-Up to Profitability
items.description: Reach full capacity of the Phase 1 plant (1,000-2,000 MT/year). Execute on export contracts. Target achieving operational break-even and first net profits.

items.title: Sustainable Growth & Expansion Planning
items.description: Begin dividend distributions to shareholders. Reinvest profits to fund planning and development of the Phase 2 industrial-scale facility (5,000+ MT/year).
